segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several say it deeply hydrates, leaves skin soft, and fixes flaky makeup application, while others report it left their face still dry or flaky, especially on the forehead, requiring multiple layers.
segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive, breakout-prone skin found it worked well under makeup, while another warns it is highly sensitizing due to fragrance and recommends the unscented version for fragrance-triggered sensitivity.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers disagree: one found it amazing with little to no fragrance and good moisturizing, while another felt it suits younger skin better and that mature skin needs something heavier.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dryness report strong hydration, a soft or dewy finish, and improved makeup application over dry patches; a minority say it left their skin still dry or flaky even after multiple layers.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, fragrance-triggered skin reports irritation risk from the scent, though another sensitive-skin reviewer reports no irritation at all.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with breakout-prone skin calls it great with no issues, and another notes it is non-comedogenic and did not cause breakouts.

aspects.libelle: Causes makeup to peel or pill

extraits.texte: This has a nice balmy texture that's not greasy. Those wirh dry skin may not find this effective on its own after it soaks in. Biggest turn-off…it's highly sensitizing due to the moderately potent fragrance. If you have sensitive skin that tends to be triggered by fragrance, try the unscented version.
